latest.title: Bott connection in the mapping cone case
latest.abstract: We generalize the concept of Bott connection to the de Rham mapping cone situation. As the main results, when the given closed smooth manifold is foliated, we have the mapping cone version of the Bott vanishing theorem and an adiabatic limit of a family of mapping cone connections on the orthogonal complement of the foliation. The second result shows the necessity of a refined metric if we want to see more interactions between geometry and topology in the mapping cone situation.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 把 Bott 联络、消失定理和绝热极限推广到 de Rham 映射锥。
latest.breakthrough: 说明精细度量对映射锥中几何拓扑相互作用的重要性。
latest.limitations: 推广对象特殊，不能直接等同于通常叶状丛结论。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.priorityReason: 结构性延伸，当前核心方向关联一般。
